newsitem.title: UK: Howard says Australia has more than Asia-only approach.
newsitem.headline: Howard says Australia has more than Asia-only approach.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said his country's economic and political future was closely linked to the Asia-Pacific region and that these ties would complement its links with the European Union and North America.
Speaking in an address to the Confederation of British Industry, Howard said his government will take an "Asia-also approach, not an Asia-only approach."
He called for further trade liberalisation and said countries belonging to the Asia-Pacific Economic Co-operation forum will push this agenda in the region.
He urged reform of the European Union's Common Agricultural Policy, saying the agricultural subsidies it gave farmers in the region had a "disproportionate impact."
He said the British economy was "robust and strong" and an attractive place to invest in Europe. He said the UK also "compares favourably with the rest of the world" as an investment destination.
